title: Samsung launches essay competition for young nature fans

sections.heading: Body
sections.text:
Samsung Engineering is marking World Environment Day by inviting young people from around the planet to enter its 10th annual essay competition.
The competition, run in partnership with UN Environment, is designed to support the World Environment Day theme of ‘Connecting People to Nature.” The prizes include a Samsung Galaxy Tab S.
“We would like to provide children and youth a chance to show their love and affection for our shared natural world by writing an essay on the value of nature,” the company said on its TUNZA Eco-Generation youth website.

## Body
Samsung Engineering is marking World Environment Day by inviting young people from around the planet to enter its 10th annual essay competition.
The competition, run in partnership with UN Environment, is designed to support the World Environment Day theme of ‘Connecting People to Nature.” The prizes include a Samsung Galaxy Tab S.
“We would like to provide children and youth a chance to show their love and affection for our shared natural world by writing an essay on the value of nature,” the company said on its TUNZA Eco-Generation youth website.
